# Line-By-Line Makers Anvil Code Guide

This generated teaching artifact explains every physical line in each implementation, automation, metadata, and structured-contract file. Read it beside the real source: in-code docstrings/comments explain components and blocks, while this guide makes blank lines, delimiters, declarations, and formats that cannot contain comments explicit.

**Purpose:** Evaluates ten required evidence classes for one allowlisted route while execution remains impossible.

**Maintenance rule:** Never create requests, accept authorization, resolve paths, construct commands, run processes, write logs, cancel, or capture proof.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/execution_request.py`

**Purpose:** Composes deterministic logical execution intent, unaccepted authorization, and empty audit plans without persistence.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep scope aligned with execution gates and never persist requests, accept consent, write events, resolve paths, or run processes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `f4263e448df16054e3dd62e07d7400c9b6a6addc2336b7839a84a20fd4ee6abe` changes intentionally.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/intake_catalog.py`

**Purpose:** Stages and reads metadata-only intake records while preserving source-file privacy and immutability.

**Maintenance rule:** Never store source paths or contents; validate runtime records before exposing them as usable intake.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/output_proof.py`

**Purpose:** Maps route previews to logical output bundles, planned artifacts, incomplete proof, and readiness blockers.

**Maintenance rule:** Never create directories or files, open outputs, capture proof, execute routes, or launch tools through preview state.

## `config/route_catalog.json`

**Purpose:** Defines deterministic metadata-kind routes, planned phases, tool families, proof blockers, and disabled actions.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep each kind unambiguous and all safety flags false until separate execution and tool gates are proven.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `10db5e19a5526633e1601b6dbf86f1d6fc175caca74b488069e91eccc4810a9e` changes intentionally.

## `config/tool_catalog.json`

**Purpose:** Defines cross-platform maker tools, PATH commands, scoped provider candidates, families, and false safety state.

**Maintenance rule:** Use generic platform providers only; never add personal paths, executable arguments, or enabled software actions.

## `frontend/public/assets/app.js`

**Purpose:** Fetches and renders read-only planning data, derives selected/expected summaries, and controls local workbench navigation.

**Maintenance rule:** Use GET only, render untrusted runtime data through text nodes, document every function, and keep operational controls disabled.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `1dd970227108a947c544473eac7ad0484848e71a6fcc2efbaf0dce884673dfd8` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/public/index.html`

**Purpose:** Defines the accessible rail, command bar, source deck, tools, workflow views, proof inspector, and Dev evidence shell.

**Maintenance rule:** Do not add mutating forms or enabled operational controls; keep every work zone uniquely identified, labeled, and commented.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `ac65dff7be574725adef2504cf632778a555ef60111ecb48d3466ac17cbf2836` changes intentionally.

<a id="source-040"></a>
## `package.json`

**Purpose:** Declares Node-facing project metadata, repository identity, engines, and convenience verification commands.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep scripts thin wrappers around canonical Python entrypoints and avoid unnecessary frontend build dependencies.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `73669b95cf13bb18f080c377d9243624db059c3bc2e87b583f417307c4f4963d` changes intentionally.

<!-- source:package.json sha256:73669b95cf13bb18f080c377d9243624db059c3bc2e87b583f417307c4f4963d lines:25 -->

| Line | Source | Explanation |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | <code>{</code> | Opens or closes a JSON object/array; nesting groups related contract fields and performs no action by itself. |

## `schemas/windows-package-plan.schema.json`

**Purpose:** Defines the pinned Windows one-file artifact plan, resource inputs, dependency versions, arguments, and false release claims.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep synchronized with build_windows_exe.py; building never implies signing, installer, publication, or clean-machine proof.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `fb98946130e2c1a1a67b6cee4a018344c9e7410d89f6cd2e445a1345118a2b25` changes intentionally.

## `scripts/build_previous_app_learning_guide.py`

**Purpose:** Generates local exact line coverage for narrowly selected first-party previous-app source while excluding dependencies and outputs.

## `scripts/build_windows_exe.py`

**Purpose:** Inspects or runs the deterministic Windows PyInstaller one-file build with bundled frontend resources.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep dependencies pinned and never install, sign, publish, or claim installer or clean-machine proof through this builder.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `45b3f0f426142830bfcfa0b63d030c04cb0c1d335c6f6c38de849f9682c3dc75` changes intentionally.

## `state/current_status.json`

**Purpose:** Stores authoritative machine-readable current pass, percentages, proof, blocked work, and next pass.

**Maintenance rule:** Update in every completed pass and never claim untested platform, packaging, or action behavior.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `1dc2afcc01e641c77624296edf85bb9f99bd3dca8ecce3304fdfa47f06ecf6f3` changes intentionally.

## `state/pass_ledger.json`

**Purpose:** Stores the ordered bounded-pass history with report links and concise proof summaries.

**Maintenance rule:** Append one entry per completed pass; do not rewrite history to hide earlier boundaries.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `2f0e9d087fc40637eedbd74b04338beb4daf298f6e8cf08a6769f8dfcc5e3af9` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_desktop.py`

**Purpose:** Proves secure native-window options, ephemeral server ownership, cleanup, smoke mode, and CLI dispatch without a GUI.

**Maintenance rule:** Inject fake pywebview behavior and never open a real window, external browser, tool, file dialog, or process in tests.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `bc6c391bad7e155ff56b97c52618a5996e9ebfcfb9637b1d4eff0e642755757e` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_execution_gate.py`

**Purpose:** Proves single-route scope, evidence mapping, out-of-scope exclusion, safety rejection, and blocked execution readiness.

**Maintenance rule:** Assert only real planning evidence passes and every authorization, containment, process, log, cancellation, and proof effect stays false.

## `tests/test_execution_request.py`

**Purpose:** Proves logical request previews, explicit unaccepted consent, empty audit records, fail-closed joins, and false effects.

**Maintenance rule:** Add negative cases whenever request scope, audit lifecycle, intent fields, or safety boundaries change.

## `tests/test_project_purity.py`

**Purpose:** Proves reference isolation, read-only frontend behavior, safe planning/job policy, durable truth, and path purity.

**Maintenance rule:** Expand when new forbidden dependencies, personal data risks, local writes, or governance rules are introduced.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `dc0b59665f10149ed197e217ae97ef61cca1493bca793669e5f7fa4d712afe04` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_route_preview.py`

**Purpose:** Proves metadata-only routing, source independence, archive non-extraction, unmatched handling, and policy rejection.

**Maintenance rule:** Exercise each new route kind and assert preview state never becomes execution or source access.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `b2d17c217a0aa206c1a75676c01adb19e8e205f4dcbebe69870107c5b92394a6` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_server.py`

**Purpose:** Proves loopback-only host validation, injectable static serving, read-only health, blocked mutation, and deterministic shutdown.

**Maintenance rule:** Use temporary bundle roots and ephemeral ports; reject every wildcard, LAN, public, and invalid bind host.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `18a83df9081c3955acff28b43c787fc15f3aeb678ef6659edea34c17353ae85a` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_tool_dry_run.py`

**Purpose:** Proves deterministic tool selection, logical references, unsupported-family honesty, policy safety, and non-execution.

**Maintenance rule:** Use isolated route/output/tool snapshots and assert no command, resolved path, handoff, process, launch, or write escapes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `0add44603a62ff8d765d90ffbcb866b2e9ca1ec4112862ba1f8e60fc5ca72f67` changes intentionally.
